The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has 32 books across 2 pages. Five books are rated five stars:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |

The last two are on page 1 and the first two are on page 2. The browser is still open on page 2 of the category.

tool_input.command:
S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; cat <<'EOF' | agent-browser --session $S eval --stdin
(async()=>{let out=[];let url=location.href;while(url){const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await (await fetch(url)).text(),'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('article.product_pod').forEach(a=>out.push([a.querySelector('p.star-rating').className,a.querySelector('h3 a').title,a.querySelector('.price_color').textContent]));const n=d.querySelector('li.next a');url=n?new URL(n.getAttribute('href'),url).href:null}return {total:out.length,five:out.filter(x=>x[0].includes('Five'))}})()
EOF
